the oath as a United States citi
zen along with 40 other aliens,

notes: Fact research lamarr-citizen-2026-11-01 (owner: find at least a naturalization year). Two independent holders state the year: NARA (Prologue caption of the INS naturalization card dated April 10, 1953) and The National WWII Museum. The Library of Congress page (Evening star, April 11, 1953, AP) is a dated contemporary report of the oath and naturalization; its OCR splits 'citizen' and 'naturalized' across lines. event_date is the year only: the April 11 report says the oath has been taken, and the April 10 report (LAM-S-0063) says she gets her citizenship that day. LAM-F-0016 (same year, 'became a U.S. citizen') stays disputed only because its Britannica browser snapshot is unreachable live (G10, rejudged 2026-11-01).
